narrative:
Ashtabula County has 58,880 registered voters, with 17.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 22.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 51.5%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 29.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 32.2% of registrants.
